---
title: "Daily Explorer"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Explore daily PRISM precipitation and temperature for the current water year,
with the preceding September included for comparisons across October 1.
Recent observations are preliminary and may be revised. The explorer shows
the latest available data date, which can lag today's date.

[Open Daily Explorer full screen](../daily-explorer/index.html){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}

<iframe id="daily-explorer-frame" src="../daily-explorer/index.html?embedded=1" title="Daily precipitation and temperature maps, timeline and notable days" style="width:100%;height:2300px;border:0;display:block" loading="eager"></iframe>

<script>
(() => {
  const frame = document.getElementById("daily-explorer-frame");
  frame.addEventListener("load", () => {
    const body = frame.contentDocument?.body;
    if (!body) return;
    const resize = () => { frame.style.height = `${Math.max(850, body.scrollHeight + 12)}px`; };
    resize();
    new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(body);
  });
})();
</script>
